mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TUNE.REFRESH_TOKENS ( TOKEN_ID, USER_ID, TOKEN_VALUE, EXPIRES_AT, REVOKED_YN ) VALUES ( SEQ_REFRESH_TOKENS.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{tokenValue}, #{expiresAt}, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REFRESH_TOKENS WHERE TOKEN_VALUE = #{refreshToken} AND REVOKED_YN = 'N' AND EXPIRES_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE REFRESH_TOKENS SET REVOKED_YN = 'Y', REVOKED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE TOKEN_VALUE = #{refreshToken}
UPDATE REFRESH_TOKENS SET TOKEN_VALUE = #{newRefreshToken}, EXPIRES_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL( #{refreshExpiration} / 1000, 'SECOND' ) WHERE TOKEN_VALUE = #{oldRefreshToken}
